Versions

Vector: 1.4.1
WPC: 1.0.0

What's Changed

This is a big one! We've been working hard this summer to bring you some new functionality, fix and tweak some existing functions and we've been working on our new hardware. Expect new things from us at the Chicago Expo!

Web UI

  • New personal bests leaderboard by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/97
  • Now when you click on the "personal" scores section you can see all personal bests in addition to your normal individual scores
  • Thanks to @romines on pinside for the idea
  • Improved discovery by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/106
  • boards will discover each other on the network much more rapidly and "remember" many more boards than before
  • Added commas to scores @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/93
  • Show release notes next to update button UI @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/99
  • Stream-lined serving of compressed files by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/112

WPC support

  • Midnight Madness control on WPC by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/102
  • Support for additional games on WPC by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/92
  • Add update checks for WPC hardware compatibility by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/115

Bug fixes

  • Fix browser cache after updates by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/94
  • Handle web page load race conditions by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/108

Development

  • multi-system-build support by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/83
  • Fix update check JS and backend by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/89
  • Add auto board detection and flashing by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/122

Versions

Vector: 1.11.10
WPC: 1.7.5

This release focuses on reliability, performance improvements, and expanded game support. Several internal improvements were also made to make configuration updates safer and easier to maintain.

Improvements

  • Reduced update memory usage. #307
  • Improved flash storage efficiency. #312
  • Config bundles are now distributed as deflate-compressed .z files to reduce download and storage size. #310
  • Cleanup and improvements to origin support. #301

Game Support & Configuration Updates

  • Added configuration for Fish Tales (L5 ROM). #299
  • Adjustments support for several Data East and Williams System 11 games. #298
  • Added System 11 frame mapping support. #313
  • Added OneBall format and fixes for initials collection. #306
  • Improved ID to name conversion for score format selection. #305

Documentation & User Resources

  • Updated README badges and documentation links. #297
  • Added documentation reference for the API over USB feature. #297
  • Updated Warped Pinball YouTube link on the About page. #294
  • Added updated phone screen capture images to the docs. #320

Build & Developer Tooling

  • Modularized and documented the game feature CSV exporter. #289
  • Automated regeneration of special feature CSV data. #296
  • CI validation for JSON configuration files. #281
  • Added PR guard for required version bumps. #295
  • Automatic patch version bumps in CI workflows. #300

Full Changelog: https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/compare/1.11.8...1.11.10

Versions

Vector: 1.11.27
WPC: 1.7.11

What's Changed

New Features

  • Switch Percents UI by @JakeSiegers in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/330

    easily see the health of every switch in the web UI at a glance, no more clicking around to find the bad switch

  • Wpc configs add by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/335

    We've added even more configs for less common ROMs. Check your machine's compatibility here: https://warpedpinball.com/compatibility.html

  • Add memory mapper support by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/327

    We've built a memory mapping tool to help mod-makers, tinkerers and nerds like us see what's happening in your pinball machine in real time. Use this to locate values you want to read or write to via the API. Check it out here: https://github.com/warped-pinball/memory-mapper

Documentation

  • Special features by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/346
  • Regenerate special features csv by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/348
  • Config updates for web site list by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/339

Bug fixes

  • Disable wifi power-save mode to fix dropped packets and unreachable web UI by @kneissl in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/363

    This should improve the reliability of the web interface

  • Bride of Pinbot Calibration Issue - RamFill by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/341
  • Improvements to CSS style loading consistency by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/364
  • Print() override to non-blocking by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/367

Developer QOL

  • Support fork prs by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/352
  • Add interactive target and port selection to sync.py by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/333
  • Add --test-data flag to sync.py by @JakeSiegers in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/358

New Contributors

    Thank you! and welcome to the project!
